asr_text: The smartphone screen is still the familiar front door to digital life, but several company announcements and rollouts point to a change: digital services are opening more doors around it. Google says Gemini Intelligence for Android will handle multi-step jobs, such as booking rides and shopping. It will start on selected Galaxy and Pixel phones, then extend to watches, cars, glasses, and laptops in 2026. Amazon describes Alexa Plus as able to carry out tasks such as ordering takeout, booking rides, and making restaurant reservations. It works through Alexa devices, Alexa.com, and the Alexa app in the United States. Now, look away from the phone. Pixel Buds 2a offer hands-free access to Gemini. A Google Translate beta sends translated speech through headphones in more than 70 languages. Gemini is also rolling out to Wear OS watches.
